description: Plain-language explanations of e-invoicing business rules, from the European standard EN 16931 and from each country's rules, starting with the French reform's BR-FR: what each rule checks, why it matters, how to fix a failing invoice, the common causes and the official text.
rules: An error code with a suffix, such as BR-FR-16_BT-152, belongs to the rule before the suffix (BR-FR-16).
Each rule's page is also on https://lintvoice.com/rules/<ID>/, in English, and https://lintvoice.com/fr/regles/<ID>/, in French.
